description_en: Deletes a Data Integration synchronization task. Currently, this operation only supports deleting real-time data synchronization tasks
description_zh: 调用DeleteDISyncTask接口，删除数据集成同步任务。当前仅支持使用该接口删除实时数据同步任务
name: DeleteDISyncTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace in which the API operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用于确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the Data Integration synchronization task. Currently, only DI_REALTIME is supported, which indicates a real-time data synchronization task
parameters.help_zh:
数据集成同步任务的类型。
当前仅支持取值为DI_REALTIME，表示实时数据同步任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the real-time data synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 实时数据同步任务的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

Data.description_en: The result of deleting the Data Integration synchronization task
Data.description_zh: 删除数据集成同步任务的结果

Message.description_en:
The cause of the deletion failure.
If the Data Integration synchronization task is successfully deleted, this parameter is left empty
Message.description_zh:
删除数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。
如果删除数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
The status of the deletion result. Valid values:
success: The Data Integration synchronization task is successfully deleted.
fail: The Data Integration synchronization task fails to be deleted. You can view the specific cause and troubleshoot the issue
Status.description_zh:
删除数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示删除数据集成同步任务成功。
fail：表示删除数据集成同步任务失败。您可以查看具体的失败原因处理问题

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
